Current menu evidence is restaurant-linked Toast, and restaurant-issued allergen evidence is directly blocked and only partially available through indexed official content; no complete allergen negatives or complete product arrays can be verified. All 18 frozen keys were reconciled once, including two narrative extraction artifacts.
